rows.58:10ac:
We left the school building and walked toward the school gate.
I tried as hard as I could not to look at Kazama.
"{b}, you're cute even in profile."
Here he goes again.
"You know, the angle of my own face I like best is forty-five degrees from the left.
You... let's see, you're cute from every angle."
Th-that's so cheesy it sets my teeth on edge.
Well, he actually is pretty good-looking.
But something about him is just weird.{p}
rows.58:1b3c:
"Oh, give me a break!"
I ran for it.
"Ah, {b}, wait...!"
As if I'd wait.
It's not much farther to my house...
If I make a dash for it, I can probably shake him off.
Maybe his stomach really did hurt; Kazama was following from somewhere behind me.{p}
